1) Required fields (please include these in any payload or CSV header):

4) Retention / compliance: by default we store event leads for 24 months; logs for 90 days. If EventWorks has shorter contractual retention windows, flag now.

Hi all — technical reply. Thanks Samir for the spec. Below is what our ingestion services expect and a small checklist to avoid mismatches during the live test.

Integration options (supported):
- Real-time webhook (preferred): POST JSON to our ingestion endpoint (we'll provide a per-event token). Content-Type: application/json. JSON example: {"email":"jane@example.com","first_name":"Jane","last_name":"Doe","company":"Acme","title":"CTO","phone":"+14155550100","badge_id":"B-12345","scan_ts":"2025-05-20T15:02:03Z","campaign_source":"GigaCon2025","marketing_consent":true,"consent_text":"I agree to be contacted by Redwood Inference about product updates, events, and related content. Redwood will store and process my data in accordance with its privacy policy."}
- Nightly CSV (fallback): UTF-8 CSV with a header row matching the attached mapping_csv_template.csv.

Field mapping notes (HubSpot / Salesforce):
- email -> contact.email (HubSpot) / Lead.Email (SF) [PRIMARY DEDUPE_KEY]
- badge_id -> property:external badge_id (string)
- campaign_source -> contact property: "redwood_event_campaign"
- marketing_consent -> boolean property: "marketing_consent" (true/false)
- consent_text -> text property: "marketing_consent_text"
- scan_ts -> appended to lead activity timestamp

Dedupe behaviour: we dedupe on email if present; otherwise use badge_id + timestamp to create a temporary lead and flag for post-event reconciliation.

Security / tokens: we prefer a short-lived bearer token for the webhook. If you cannot support OAuth for HubSpot, provide a HubSpot API key restricted to contacts creation for this customer. Never send PII over plain HTTP.

Retention: default TTL for event leads is 24 months (configurable per account). Audit logs kept 90 days. If EventWorks requires an earlier deletion, we can set a TTL per-campaign.

On the mapping_csv_template.csv I've included the exact header names we expect. Samir — can you share a sample CSV export (one or two rows) so we can validate columns before the smoke test? Also send your preferred webhook URL and whether the scanner will POST Content-Type: application/json or application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

I'll stand by for the May 20 smoke test.

Thanks,
